review_candidates.title: IT Operations Executive
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Open Government Products (OGP) operates like a startup within the government; We are a fast-paced, dynamic team of engineers, designers, and product managers dedicated to public good. We autonomously identify opportunities to solve public problems using tech, rapidly prototype, and launch solutions—from citizen apps to automating public agency operations. Embracing an open-sourced and flat hierarchy, we cut through bureaucracy to focus on real-world, user-centric innovations that drive change. About The Role This is a 1-year fixed-term contract role. Any extension beyond the initial contract period will be considered based on business needs at that time and is not guaranteed. We're hiring an IT Operations hire to own the execution layer: service desk, device management, onboarding and off-boarding, and documentation. You will report to the IT Manager and work closely with the Workplace team. This is a hands-on, on-the-ground role. You'll be the first point of contact for IT requests across OGP — the person who makes sure officers can get set up and get unstuck. On a Day-to-day Basis, This Means Service Desk Be the first point of contact for all IT requests via ticketing system, Slack, and email — triaging, responding, and resolving. Handle password resets, MFA issues, and basic Okta troubleshooting (account unlocks, app assignments). Support staff with SaaS access — helping people get into the cloud tools OGP uses (Google Workspace, 1Password, Slack, Notion). Troubleshoot Mac issues: OS problems, software installs, connectivity, peripheral setup, hardware fixes. Provide first-level support for meeting room AV and displays — resolving common issues and escalating where needed. Onboarding & Offboarding Execute the IT onboarding checklist for every new hire — device prep, account creation, and day-one setup. Run IT offboarding — account suspension, device collection, and access revocation. Maintain and keep the onboarding/offboarding runbook up to date so the process is documented and repeatable. Asset Management Maintain the hardware register — track procurement, assignment, return, and disposal for all devices. Monitor device lifecycle, warranty status, and stock levels; coordinate repairs and loaner assignments. Keep inventory records accurate after every movement; run quarterly stocktakes. Documentation Create and maintain Knowledge Base (KB) articles — building a self-service resource for staff and future reference. Maintain and update runbooks as processes are built and refined. Draft clear, staff-friendly self-serve guides for common faced issues. Preferred Skills And Qualifications Proficient in supporting macOS hardware and common enterprise tools, including Okta, Google Workspace, 1Password, and Slack Demonstrate strong aptitude for learning and are comfortable investigating unfamiliar technical problems Communicate clearly and effectively — both with staff seeking support and with the IT manager, ensuring a clear and accurate picture of ongoing issues Organised and process-oriented, with a habit of documenting work and identifying opportunities to improve repeatability and efficiency Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership, reliability, and responsiveness Nice to Have Experience with MDM/UEM tools (e.g. Jamf, Intune, Kandji) Prior experience in IT support, helpdesk operations, or systems administration Foundational knowledge of broader IT domains such as networking, security, or IT Service Management Relevant certifications, such as CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, or CompTIA Network+ Familiarity with ITSM/ticketing platforms (e.g. Freshservice, Jira Service Management, Zendesk) Understanding of automation concepts and familiarity with building workflows to streamline repetitive tasks Working at OGP Ownership and Autonomy — Beyond technical tasks, this means having autonomy to voice opinions and suggest future directions. Building what you believe in drives the creation of great solutions. Rapid Prototyping — We prioritize testing ideas over debating them, allowing us to identify problems quickly and convey possibilities to others. This fail-fast approach accelerates innovation. Flexibility — We provide flexible work arrangements based on what works best for our team and its members, fostering a productive and supportive environment. Continuous Learning — Drive professional growth by exploring new architectures, frameworks, and technologies. With dedicated yearly learning months and hackathons, continuous learning is essential as we tackle innovative ideas and challenges. Mission-Driven — Our work is dedicated to the public good, aiming to improve the lives of Singapore citizens. We focus on creating impactful solutions that enhance the community and the place we call home. Projects OGP Has Worked On Include ScamShield — iOS and Android mobile apps, enhanced in August 2024, help users check and report suspicious communications. The apps automatically filter known scams using an AI-powered machine learning classifier. An Admin Dashboard also allows police to verify reported scams. ParkingSG — A mobile app alternative to parking coupons. It lets users pay, extend, and refund their parking sessions just using their phones. RedeemSG — Helps the Singapore Government to create, send and track redemptions of digital vouchers easily. COVID-19 Vaccination — A suite of systems built to enable Singapore's national vaccination campaign for COVID-19. This includes informational sites, appointment booking systems, and records management systems. data.gov.sg — An open repository of all the Singapore Government's public data. It helps people understand the data using visualizations and articles, and provides real-time APIs for developers to use. Isomer — Provides government agencies with an easy-to-deploy static website building and hosting service to create usable, secure and faster informational websites quickly. FormSG — A form builder tool for agencies to self-service and create online forms that capture classified data, with the goal of replacing paper forms. PaySG — Was developed to enable digital payments for government services, and was initially used for payments for COVID-19 swab tests and Stay-Home Notices for incoming travellers to Singapore. An overview of other OGP products can be found on our website https://open.gov.sg

Provision, maintain, and scale cloud resources in Microsoft Azure in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Monitor cloud resource utilization to ensure cost efficiency and scalability. Troubleshoot and resolve system, application, and infrastructure issues, performing root cause analysis as needed. Ensure infrastructure meets security, compliance, and operational standards within a DevSecOps framework. Support CI/CD pipelines and integrate infrastructure automation into the development lifecycle. Implement and manage containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, for microservices architectures. Configure and maintain monitoring tools to ensure system and application availability and performance. Identify and implement optimizations to improve efficiency, reduce latency, and enhance system uptime. Apply security best practices, including identity and access management (IAM), network segmentation, and encryption, to protect hybrid cloud infrastructures. Assist in audits and compliance initiatives (e.g., RMF, NIST, ISO 27001). Provide Tier-2/3 support for escalated issues, working closely with internal teams and external vendors. Document procedures, configurations, and troubleshooting steps to enhance knowledge sharing. Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of experience or a Master’s degree with 2+ years of experience. Additional years of experience will be accepted in lieu of a degree. Must have a DoD 8140 Intermediate certification (Security+ CE or equivalent) (formerly DoD-8570 IAT Level 2 baseline certification). Intermediate Azure Certifications such as AZ-104: Azure Administrator Associate or similar certifications from other Cloud Service Providers. Proficiency in virtualization technologies, including VMware, Hyper-V, and OpenStack. Proficiency in public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, and CloudFormation. Solid understanding of containerization (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes). Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) and incident management. Solid Understanding of networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, VPNs, and firewalls. Practical knowledge of DevSecOps principles, methodologies, and best practices. Interest in continuous learning and professional development in cybersecurity and DevOps practices. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Air Force programs. Experience with security tools and practices related to DevSecOps (e.g., SAST, DAST, IAST). Experience with compliance standards (e.g., OWASP, NIST) and DoD regulations. Expert cloud certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or similar certification from another cloud provider. Experience with Azure Stack Edge family of devices. Experience with DoD networks, especially classified and operational networks. Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, especially Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), tunneling, QoS, and cloud connectivity solutions (e.g. Azure Express Route). Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and security automation. DABAOPP1 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. Experience supporting field operations, terminal integration, or on orbit‑ performance assessment environments. Supported prototype development, system demonstrations, or rapid capability insertion efforts. Contributed to terminal interoperability upgrades or RF enhancements that improved mission performance. Exposure to relevant industries, customers, or mission sets Experience in SATCOM, RF communications, tactical radios, aerospace systems, or defense networking. Past support for U.S. Government, DoD, or national security customers conducting mission critical‑ communications. Familiarity with protected communications, jamming environments, spectrum policy, and cybersecurity aware‑ RF architectures. review_candidates.description: About Kimedics Kimedics is transforming the way healthcare organizations manage their workforce. We’re growing quickly and building an engineering organization where innovation, reliability, and trust are foundational. The Role The Platform team at Kimedics builds and operates the infrastructure foundation that every product team depends on. We own the cloud platform running on Azure, the container orchestration layer, the identity and security posture, and the observability systems that keep our services healthy and our engineers informed. This is a hands-on technical role. You'll design and build real systems, contribute to meaningful infrastructure decisions, and work across the stack from networking, IAM, and Azure services, to CI/CD pipelines and code repository configuration. As you grow into the role, you'll help shape how the team works: contributing to technical standards, giving thoughtful peer reviews, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll be supported by senior engineers as you build toward deeper ownership. If you're someone who finds satisfaction in making platform infrastructure simple and reliable for the engineers who depend on it, and who takes the security and compliance obligations of healthcare software seriously, this role is worth a close look, even if you don't check every box below. What You Will Do Infrastructure and Cloud Platform You'll design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on Azure using infrastructure-as-code practices. Terraform, Kubernetes, and Azure service operators are part of our daily vocabulary. We treat infrastructure as software: version controlled, reviewed, tested, and documented. You'll contribute to that standard, with support to help raise it as you grow into the role. Container Workloads and Kubernetes We use Azure Container Services and will be moving toward Kubernetes. You'll help own workload configuration, deployment patterns, resource management, and cluster health, building your understanding of containerized systems at scale with guidance from senior teammates. Networking and Security Platform engineers here work at the network and identity layer, not above it. You'll help design and maintain virtual network topology, firewall rules, private endpoints, and service connectivity. Identity and access management is a first-class concern: we're actively hardening our IAM posture against SOC2 Type 2 and HITRUST requirements, and you'll play a real role in that work as you build your expertise. Observability, Logging, and Alerting You understand that a system you can't observe is a system you can't trust. You'll help build and maintain the logging pipelines, metrics infrastructure, dashboards, and alerting rules that keep the team ahead of issues rather than chasing them. Systems Design and Architecture Platform work requires thinking in systems. You'll weigh in on tradeoffs across reliability, security, cost, and operational complexity, and contribute to architecture decisions and ADRs, growing your systems-thinking skills alongside more senior engineers on the team. What You Bring 4 to 6 or more years of professional engineering experience, with a solid foundation in cloud or infrastructure engineering. Hands-on experience with Azure: compute, networking, storage, identity, and managed services. You're comfortable working beyond the surface level and eager to keep going deeper. Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling; Terraform and GitOps with Azure-native service operators experience is a plus, but not required on day one. Some Kubernetes experience, or strong container-orchestration fundamentals and a genuine interest in building deeper Kubernetes skills: workload configuration, namespace and RBAC design, and resource management. Working knowledge of cloud networking fundamentals: Zero Trust networking, VNets, subnets, NSGs, private endpoints, DNS, and service connectivity patterns. Understanding of identity and access management in Azure, including Entra ID, managed identities, and role assignments. Exposure to compliance-driven IAM work (SOC2, HITRUST, HIPAA) is a plus, not a requirement. Some experience with, or strong interest in, observability systems: structured logging, metrics pipelines, distributed tracing, and alert design that reduces noise rather than adding to it. Solid system design instincts and a growing ability to hold a complex system in your head, identify where it's fragile, and propose practical improvements. A genuine orientation toward collaboration. You give useful code reviews, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to people outside your immediate domain, and take ownership of team outcomes rather than just your own ticket queue. Experience in healthcare, fintech, or other regulated industries is a plus, not required. Why Join Kimedics? You’ll play a central role in shaping our analytics platform and influencing how healthcare organizations make operational and financial decisions. This is a strategic, high‑impact product role with room to innovate, build, and scale. This role offers a full benefits package with Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, and more.
